en: A sepia-toned historical city square scene with early 20th-century cars parked along the street and people dressed in period attire walking or standing around. The buildings are eclectic European urban architecture. The bottom edge contains Cyrillic script giving the location as 'Varna, Musalla Square (Nezavisimost)' with a number, suggesting this is a vintage postcard. The reverse has handwritten notes in Cyrillic (Bulgarian language) with 'CARTE POSTALE' printed at the top.
